evals.prompt: When I call `format_price(0.1 + 0.2)` it returns `'0.30000000000000004'` instead of `'0.30'`. Steps to reproduce: call `format_price(0.1 + 0.2)` in a Python REPL.
evals.expected_output: Skill investigates root cause (floating point), writes a concrete failing test, scans for related gaps (e.g. other float inputs), shows tests, asks user to confirm fix approach (Fix now / Create plan / Something else), and if confirmed inline — applies minimal fix and verifies green.

assertions.name: prints_phase1_summary

assertions.name: identifies_root_cause

evals.prompt: Our payment processing pipeline is broken after the v2 refactor. When a user submits a payment with a non-ASCII billing name (e.g. 'François Müller'), the PaymentGatewayService raises UnicodeEncodeError mid-transaction, leaving the order in a partial state in the DB. Steps to reproduce: submit any order with a non-ASCII character in the billing name. The fix requires: (1) encoding normalisation across PaymentGatewayService, BillingAddressValidator, InvoiceRenderer, and AuditLogger — all four need to handle unicode consistently; (2) a new UnicodeNormalizer utility class used by all of them; (3) DB migration to change the billing_name column from VARCHAR(100) to NVARCHAR(100); (4) updating the Order schema model. This touches 6+ files and the data model.
evals.expected_output: Skill investigates the call chain, identifies encoding root cause, writes failing tests, estimates token cost > 20k given 6+ files + schema + migration, recommends create-plan, but still presents all three options to the user.

assertions.name: announces_skill_at_start
assertions.description: Skill announces 'Using debug' at the start of the response

assertions.name: traces_call_chain
assertions.description: Investigation traces PaymentGatewayService and related components in the encoding failure path

assertions.name: writes_failing_test
assertions.description: Writes at least one concrete failing test reproducing the UnicodeEncodeError with a non-ASCII billing name

assertions.name: estimates_token_cost
assertions.description: Provides a token cost estimate exceeding 20k tokens given 6+ files, new utility class, and DB migration

assertions.name: recommends_create_plan
assertions.description: Recommends routing to /create-plan because estimated cost > 20k tokens

assertions.name: asks_user_confirmation
assertions.description: Uses AskUserQuestion with all three options: Fix now, Create plan, Something else — does not auto-proceed
